parsed.text: Summary of supplied distributions (4×4 grid, rows increase downward, columns rightward). Panel p0 current: nodes n0–n2 are copied prior records (not new estimates); n0 shows blue peaked at (row0,col1) and red peaked at (0,3). n1 and n2 are uniform for both roles. n3 (history estimate) has blue peak at (1,2) and red peak at (0,1). Panel p0 conditional candidate records (k0,k1,k2) repeat the same peaks per node; for n3 all three candidate commands also peak blue at (1,2) and red at (0,1) though probabilities differ across candidates. Panel p1 current: n0–n2 mirror p0 patterns and are completed-record origins; n3 is uniform for both roles. Panel p1 conditional candidates differ at n3 across commands: k0 places blue peaks on the four cells (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) and red peaks on the four cells (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1); k1 places blue peak at (0,1) and red at (0,3); k2 places blue peak at (1,2) and red at (0,1). Conditional command records are conditional estimates, not events that have occurred.
